jobs.description:
Über uns

Wir verzaubern die Welt mit Schokolade! Die Lindt & Sprüngli (Schweiz) AG ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der globalen Lindt & Sprüngli Gruppe mit Hauptsitz und Produktionsstätte in Kilchberg am Zürichsee. In Altendorf betreiben wir unser eigenes Logistikzentrum, während das Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten Kakaomasse für unseren Eigenbedarf sowie für andere europäische Produktionsstätten herstellt. In der ganzen Schweiz betreiben wir stolz 15 Lindt Shops, darunter ikonische Standorte wie das Jungfraujoch und das Verkehrshaus der Schweiz in Luzern. Über 1000 Mitarbeitende aus mehr als 50 Nationen tragen zu unserem Erfolg bei.

Was du bei uns machst:

• Störungssuche an den Anlagen sowie der Infrastruktur

• Durchführen von Unterhalts-, Revisions- und Umbauarbeiten

• Verantwortlich für Arbeiten an der Telefonanlage/-zentrale

• Verantwortlich für die Revision und Störungsbehebung

• Überwachen von Inbetriebsetzungen

• Unterstützen in der Lernendenausbildung

Wann du zu uns passt:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Betriebselektriker*in / Automatiker*in EFZ

• Weiterbildung zur/zum Techniker*in HF von Vorteil

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung zwingend

• Grundkenntnisse in der Netzwerktechnik

• Fundierte Automations- (Siemens S7 & TIA Portal) sowie Servotechnik-Erfahrung zwingend

• Bereitschaft für Pikettdienst sowie Schichtarbeit (3-Schicht)

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

• Selbstständiges, pflichtbewusstes und sorgfältiges Arbeiten

• Kommunikative sowie aufgestellte Persönlichkeit

Wir sind alle einzigartig!
Wir rekrutieren frei von Vorurteilen und berücksichtigen Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen unbeeinflusst von persönlichen Merkmalen wie Geschlecht, Alter, sexuelle Orientierung, Herkunft, Religion, Familienstand, Beeinträchtigungen, etc.

Wohlbefinden
Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Mit einer Sportprämie, Ergonomieberatung, gesunder Ernährung und weiteren Gesundheitsinitiativen unterstützen wir dich dabei fit zu bleiben.

Entwicklung
Lernen wird bei uns GROSS geschrieben. Für die persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung stehen dir verschiedene spannende Möglichkeiten zur Verfügung.

Mobilität
Wir unterstützen dich mit einer monatlichen Mobilitätsprämie und E-Bikes vor Ort. Zudem kannst du auch von der REKA-Card profitieren.

Familienfreundliches Umfeld - richtig versichert
Unsere Sozialversicherungen, wie auch der Mutterschaftsurlaub, gehen weit über das Obligatorische hinaus - zum eigenen Schutz sowie für deine Liebsten.

Flexibilität
Je nach Funktion sind flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home Office sowie Teilzeitarbeit möglich. Zudem bieten wir dir die Option, die Ferientage zu erhöhen.

Vergünstigung
Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen wie ein top Personalrestaurant, Rabatte in den Lindt Shops oder tolle Freizeitangebote stehen dir zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Su di noi

Incantiamo il mondo con il cioccolato! Lindt & Sprüngli (Svizzera) AG è una filiale del gruppo globale Lindt & Sprüngli con sede e impianti produttivi a Kilchberg sul lago di Zurigo. In Altendorf operiamo il nostro centro logistico, mentre il Lindt Cocoa Center di Olten produce la massa di cacao per il nostro utilizzo e per altri impianti produttivi europei. In tutta la Svizzera, operiamo con orgoglio 15 negozi Lindt, tra cui luoghi iconici come Jungfraujoch e la Swiss Transport House di Lucerna. Più di 1000 dipendenti di oltre 50 nazioni contribuiscono al nostro successo.

Cosa fai con noi:

• risoluzione dei problemi di installazioni e infrastrutture

• Eseguire lavori di manutenzione, revisione e conversione

• Responsabile del lavoro sul sistema telefonico/centrale

• Responsabile per la revisione e la risoluzione dei problemi

• Monitoraggio delle operazioni di messa in servizio

• Supporto per l'apprendimento

Quando ti trovi con noi:

• Formazione completa come elettricista aziendale / tecnico automatico EFZ

• Ulteriore formazione per / per il tecnico HF è un vantaggio

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale

• Conoscenza di base della tecnologia di rete

• Automazione approfondita (Siemens S7 & TIA Portal) e esperienza di tecnologia servo

• Prontezza per Picetting Service e lavoro a turni (3-shift)

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco

• Lavoro indipendente, dutioso e attento

• Personalità comunicativa ed elevata

Siamo tutti unici!
Reclutiamo senza pregiudizi e consideriamo le competenze e le qualifiche non influenzate da caratteristiche personali come il sesso, l'età, l'orientamento sessuale, l'origine, la religione, lo stato civile, i difetti, ecc.

Salute
La salute è importante per noi. Con un bonus sportivo, consigli ergonomici, nutrizione sana e altre iniziative di salute, ti aiutiamo a rimanere in forma.

Sviluppo
Imparare è scritto GRANDE con noi. Per lo sviluppo personale e professionale, diverse possibilità emozionanti sono a vostra disposizione.

Mobilità
Ti supportiamo con un bonus mensile di mobilità e e-bike in loco. È inoltre possibile usufruire della REKA-Card.

Ambiente familiare - adeguatamente assicurato
La nostra assicurazione sociale, così come il congedo di maternità, va ben oltre l'obbligo - per la vostra protezione e per i vostri cari.

Flessibilità
A seconda della funzione, ore di lavoro flessibili, ufficio domestico e lavoro part-time sono possibili. Vi offriamo anche la possibilità di aumentare i giorni di vacanza.

Vantaggio
Numerosi vantaggi come un ristorante di alto livello, sconti nei negozi Lindt o grandi offerte di svago sono a vostra disposizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with headquarters and production facilities in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics centre, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own use as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland, we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss Transport House in Lucerne. More than 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

What you do with us:

• troubleshooting of installations and infrastructure

• Carrying out maintenance, revision and conversion work

• Responsible for work on the telephone system/central

• Responsible for revision and troubleshooting

• Monitoring of commissioning operations

• Support for learning

When you fit in with us:

• Completed training as a company electrician / automatic technician EFZ

• Further training for/to the technician HF is an advantage

• Several years of professional experience

• Basic knowledge of network technology

• In-depth automation (Siemens S7 & TIA Portal) and servo technology experience

• Readiness for Picetting Service and shift work (3-shift)

• Very good knowledge of German

• Independent, dutiful and careful work

• Communicative and elevated personality

We are all unique!
We recruit free from prejudice and consider skills and qualifications unaffected by personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Health
Health is important to us. With a sports bonus, ergonomics advice, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives, we support you to stay fit.

Development
Learning is written BIG with us. For personal and professional development, various exciting possibilities are available to you.

Mobility
We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA-Card.

Family-friendly environment - properly insured
Our social insurance, as well as maternity leave, goes far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection and for your loved ones.

Flexibility
Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the holiday days.

Advantage
Numerous perks such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure offers are at your disposal.

Selon la fonction, des horaires de travail flexibles, le bureau à domicile et le travail à temps partiel sont possibles. Nous vous offrons également la possibilité d'augmenter les jours fériés.

Avantages
De nombreux avantages tels qu'un restaurant haut de gamme, des réductions dans les magasins Lindt ou de grandes offres de loisirs sont à votre disposition.

jobs.title: Unsolicited Application
jobs.description:
We enchant the World with Chocolate - Shape the Future with Us!

Join Lindt & Sprüngli and become part of a company where passion, quality and entrepreneurial spirit come together.
We are always interested in meeting talented individuals who are eager to contribute their expertise, bring fresh perspectives and grow with us. Whether your background is in business, marketing, supply chain, finance, HR or another specialist area, we welcome proactive applications from people who share our commitment to excellence and our passion for creating exceptional experiences. If you would like to be part of an international, dynamic and purpose-driven environment, we look forward to hearing from you.

What you can contribute
As part of our international environment, you may have the opportunity to:

• Contribute your expertise to impactful projects and business initiatives

• Bring ideas to continuously improve our ways of working

• Collaborate across functions, markets, and cultures

• Take ownership of your responsibilities and drive results with a hands-on mindset

• Support the delivery of premium products and exceptional brand experiences

What we are looking for
We are interested in individuals who demonstrate:

• A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative

• Passion for quality, excellence, and continuous improvement

• A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills

• Curiosity, adaptability, and openness to learning

• Professional experience or academic background relevant to your field of interest

• Fluency in English (additional languages are an asset in our international environment)

Note: This posting does not refer to a specific open position. Your application will be kept on file, and we will contact you as soon as a suitable position becomes available that matches your qualifications and professional experience. We do not accept CVs from executive search companies and headhunters.

• Un senso di responsabilità

jobs.title: Head of Group Information Security
jobs.description:
Your main responsibilities will include:

• Provide leadership, direction, and advocacy to effectively manage the cybersecurity program.

• Develop and implement the agreed cybersecurity strategy in alignment with the business and IT strategy.

• Oversee staff, infrastructure, policy enforcement, and/or other resources.

• Drive the development of policies & standards and advocate for change that will support new initiatives or required changes and enhancements.

• Apply knowledge of risk assessment data of identified threats to decision-making processes.

• Acquire and manage the necessary resources, including third party security service providers, to support security goals, and reduce overall organizational risk.

• Advise senior management on risk levels and security posture.

• Communicate the value of security throughout all levels of the organization's stakeholders.

• Monitor threats, conduct investigations, support inquiries, and take preventive measures to improve business resilience.

• Develop and provide security guidance for new and existing systems,

• applications, and services; this includes weighing business needs, internal governance standards, and third-party compliance requirements.

• Partner with subsidiary IT teams to establish and track regional and global priorities for security initiatives.

• Provide regular reporting on security initiatives to the Head of Group IT and senior management.

• Provide leadership regarding security for assets and data, both on-premises and cloud-based.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and product categories to determine where they fill gaps, overlap with existing solutions, or extend capabilities.

• Implement and maintain security systems, applications, and services that provide detection, preventions, containment and deterrence mechanisms to protect corporate data.

• Lead the selection, testing, and deployment of new security solutions.

• Document security requirements by evaluating business needs, internal governance standards, and third-party & customer compliance requirements.

• Manage relationships with existing and future managed security service providers (MSSPs) that contribute to the portfolio of security services.

• Manage and coordinate response to security incidents.

• Facilitate compliance with audit, legal, regulatory, and customer contract requirements.

• Analyse and evaluate security operations to identify risks or opportunities for improvement.

Your profile:

• The position requires a Bachelor's degree and at least fifteen (15) years of related experience with a minimum of six (6) years of technical experience in one or

• more of the following: computer and network security, cloud-based security

• architecture, vulnerability testing, intrusion detection/prevention, security

• monitoring and event correlation, or computer forensic analysis.

• Relevant Information Security certifications (ex. CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, MCSE, CEH, CHFI, CISA, CISM, CRISC, etc.)

• Highly-developed communications skills (written/verbal) and interpersonal savvy

• Results/action-orientation; project management skills.

• Organizational and political agility; developed negotiation and influence skills.

• Unquestionable personal code of ethics, integrity, diversity and trust.

• Able to successfully navigate within varying degrees of ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

• Prior experience working in a global, decentralized organization.

• Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity principles.

• Extensive knowledge of cyber threats and vulnerabilities.

• Skill in de-conflicting cyber operations and activities.

About us

We enchant the world with chocolate! Lindt & Sprüngli (Switzerland) AG is a subsidiary of the global Lindt & Sprüngli Group with headquarters and production facilities in Kilchberg on Lake Zurich. In Altendorf we operate our own logistics centre, while the Lindt Cocoa Center in Olten produces cocoa mass for our own use as well as for other European production facilities. Throughout Switzerland, we proudly operate 15 Lindt shops, including iconic locations such as the Jungfraujoch and the Swiss Transport House in Lucerne. More than 1000 employees from more than 50 nations contribute to our success.

For our Lindt Café in Kilchberg, we are looking for reliable and committed support immediately or by appointment.

What you do with us:

• Production of food in the kitchen and stocking of sales cases in the Centerpiece

• Active cooperation in the guest area in the café (Center Piece)

• Assuming a wide range of tasks in the kitchen as well as in service

• Cooperation in the development of new products

If you suit us:

• Completed basic training as chef/chef EFZ or comparable training

• Professional experience in a comparable capacity

• Negotiable German and English, other foreign languages are advantageous

• Proactive, upstanding and honest personality

• Resilience, flexibility and openness to change

• “Host gene” and willingness to go the extra mile

We are all unique!

We recruit free from prejudice and consider skills and qualifications unaffected by personal characteristics such as gender, age, sexual orientation, origin, religion, marital status, impairments, etc.

Health
Health is important to us. With a sports bonus, ergonomics advice, healthy nutrition and other health initiatives, we support you to stay fit.

Development
Learning is written BIG with us. For personal and professional development, various exciting possibilities are available to you.

We support you with a monthly mobility bonus and e-bikes on site. You can also benefit from the REKA-Card.

Our social insurance, as well as maternity leave, goes far beyond the mandatory - for your own protection and for your loved ones.

Flexibility
Depending on the function, flexible working hours, home office and part-time work are possible. We also offer you the option to increase the holiday days.

Advantage
Numerous perks such as a top staff restaurant, discounts in the Lindt shops or great leisure offers are at your disposal.
